name: kappaemme-git/first-customer-finder
description: A first-customer research skill for Codex that finds evidence-backed first customers from public signals. It explicitly does not send outreach automatically, and numerical scores cannot override contradictory or missing evidence. It needs no third-party Python dependencies, data-broker subscription, or skill-specific API key per README. Note: Requires user-supplied API credentials for external data access.
install: npx --yes codex-first-customer-finder-skill@latest into the Codex skills directory, plus git clone plus node scripts/install.js for a source checkout.
